heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Bioweapons Engineering
scoreArea.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Cortical Cybermodem
rig.rulesText: Provides +2 MU and +2 hand size. Put [2] from the bank on Cortical Cybermodem when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: Airport Locker
rig.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Retreat
scoreArea.rulesText: You lose the following ability as soon as you rez or install any card. A: Gain [2].

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Vacant Soulkiller
root.rulesText: You may advance Vacant Soulkiller before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Vacant Soulkiller, it does 1 brain damage for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: Corprunner's Shattered Remains
root.rulesText: You may advance Shattered Remains before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Shattered Remains, trash one piece of hardware for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: Setup!
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

setAside.title: Rent-I-Con
setAside.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

setAside.title: Cloak
setAside.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

setAside.title: R&D Interface
setAside.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.
